svg.title: TGCP: Text-Guarded Canonical Projection
svg.desc: TGCP method overview aligned to the current manuscript. Native ECG crops are exact pixel excerpts from the same four saved experimental paired renderings. Common crop and scale preserve calibration differences. No normalized ECG output is depicted. Orange denotes raw/canonical fields, purple learned alignment, pink restoration and green retained alignment. Readout icons are schematic. The method requires all four views at inference.
svg.text: (2) Canonical alignment and joint inference with all four views
